w3Mentions.name: Gavel
w3Mentions.firstLine: Back at the haven the argument starts: Dante is calling it "Old Gavel." Nobody agrees yet — weigh in if you want.

w3Mentions.name: The Callback
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🐗 RAID — 4 raiders (The Callback, Big Big, Grief Counselor, Old Big) hit Haven in the night, drawn by the smell of the pantry! The palisade's stakes take their toll as they come over the wall.

loss.line: Haven couldn't hold. On the third hungry day, people started walking — in different directions. The scattering, again.
